exposure.needed: whether the Loki configuration file or command-line flags set experimental.ruler.enable-api

consequence.statement: A configuration still setting experimental.ruler.enable-api no longer has that option honoured, because it is removed.

assertion.statement: The deprecated configuration option `experimental.ruler.enable-api` is removed in Loki 3.0.0; use `ruler.enable-api` instead.
